title: Border and Ghost
author: Lena Sterling
blurb: Ivo Voss, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
